name: INV-01 - Process Invoice
purpose: Process PDF invoices uploaded to SharePoint, extract data with AI Builder, validate confidence, prevent duplicates, persist to Dataverse, route approvals, and notify users.

trigger.action: When a file is created (properties only)

actions.name: Extract invoice
actions.notes: Pass SharePoint file content. Capture Invoice ID, Vendor Name, Purchase Order, dates, Subtotal, Total Tax, Invoice Total, Amount Due and required confidence scores.

actions.name: Compose Record Name
actions.notes: Stable Dataverse primary-name value even when extraction is incomplete.

actions.name: Condition - required extraction trustworthy
actions.notes: Require non-empty Invoice ID and Vendor Name, non-null Invoice Total, and confidence >= cyg_MinimumConfidence for all three required fields.

actions.name: Needs Review - create row
actions.notes: Store nullable extracted fields, confidence values, source metadata, blank Duplicate Key, status Needs Review and a clear review reason. Then notify Finance and terminate this branch.

actions.name: Compose Duplicate Key
actions.expression: concat(toLower(trim(<AI Builder Vendor Name>)),'|',toLower(trim(<AI Builder Invoice ID>)))

actions.name: List matching invoices
actions.notes: Filter cyg_duplicatekey by the safely escaped duplicate key; Top Count 1.

actions.name: Condition - duplicate exists
actions.ifYes: Notify submitter/Finance that the invoice already exists and terminate without inserting another normal invoice row.
actions.ifNo: Create the invoice row and continue.

actions.name: Create Invoice row
actions.notes: Write the stable Record Name, extracted values, confidence values, source file metadata, duplicate key and status New. The alternate key is the final concurrency safeguard.

actions.name: Auto approval branch
actions.notes: Set status Approved and approved-on timestamp.

actions.name: Manager approval branch
actions.action: Start and wait for an approval
actions.notes: For total > auto limit and <= manager limit, assign cyg_ManagerApproverEmail. On approve set Approved; on reject set Rejected and persist comments.

actions.name: High-value manager approval
actions.action: Start and wait for an approval
actions.notes: For total > manager limit, manager must approve first.

actions.name: High-value finance approval
actions.action: Start and wait for an approval
actions.notes: Run only after manager approval. Assign cyg_FinanceApproverEmail.

actions.name: Notify Teams
actions.action: Post message in a chat or channel
actions.notes: Post final or exception status to the configured Finance team/channel.

actions.name: Notify submitter
actions.notes: Send invoice number, supplier, amount, status and source link.

errorHandling.pattern: Wrap processing in TRY scopes and a CATCH scope configured for failure/timeout. If a Dataverse row exists, update cyg_processingerror; always notify Finance.
errorHandling.concurrency: Keep the Dataverse alternate key on cyg_duplicatekey. If two identical valid invoices race after the pre-check, the second insert fails and is handled as a duplicate/concurrency exception rather than creating two records.
errorHandling.sensitiveData: Enable Secure Inputs/Outputs on the AI Builder action and any action containing invoice content when required by the organisation.
